caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The chair is constructed from thick, round logs that form the legs, backrest, and support structure, all rendered in shades of light brown with visible wood grain texture. The backrest consists of two horizontal slats connected to two vertical posts. The seat is made of a woven material, also brown, arranged in crisscross strips between the wooden frame. Each joint of the chair, where the wooden logs intersect, is clearly depicted. There is a visible artist's signature, "F. HASTINGS," in small capital letters at the bottom right corner of the image. There are no additional objects, decorations, or features in the drawing.
title: Hickory High Chair
